concept: Being kind to someone even when it's socially costly to do so
source_inspiration: original content, informed by Nightingale's service tradition — not sourced from any external text

exercise.scenario: Student sees a peer being excluded or struggling, where reaching out carries genuine social risk
exercise.branching_choice: Student decides how to respond, balancing kindness with real social stakes
exercise.practice: Socratic follow-up on what made the choice difficult and what mattered most in making it

assessment.success_marker: student names the specific social cost they weighed, not just the abstract value of kindness
